title: Best Kids Toothbrush 2026: 5 brushes tested for plaque removal and kid compliance
description: Oral-B Disney, Philips Sonicare Kids, Brusheez, Frida SmileFrida, Colgate Manual — 6 kids tested 60 days. Plaque score, brushing compliance, parent intervention required.
lede: Five kids' toothbrushes tested by 6 children ages 2-8 over 60 days. We measured plaque score reduction, daily brushing compliance, and battery life.
methodology: 6 kids ages 2-8 brushed 2x/day with each toothbrush rotated weekly. Plaque scored by dentist at baseline, day 30, day 60. Compliance = brushed without parent reminder.

sections.heading: Plaque score and compliance
paragraphs: Oral-B Disney electric: 78% plaque reduction (best), 92% compliance (Magic Timer app gamifies brushing). Philips Sonicare Bluetooth: 75% reduction, 88% compliance. Brusheez: 70%, 85%.

Frida SmileFrida manual (triple-angle): 60% reduction, 70% compliance — best for 1-3 year olds. Colgate manual: 55% reduction, 60% compliance. Electric beats manual on plaque, but compliance gap closes when kids find the brush fun.

faqs.a: Electric (Oral-B, Philips) at age 3+ when kid can hold steady. Manual (Frida, Colgate) for ages 1-3. The triple-angle manual brushes (Frida) reach all surfaces simultaneously — better for parent-assisted brushing.

Oral-B Magic Timer app increased our test kids' compliance by 32% over plain electric. Worth it for kids 4-8 who respond to gamification. For 2-4 year olds, character themes (Disney, Frozen) work better than apps.

oral-b-kids-electric-disney.review: Best plaque + compliance. Rotating brush head, sensitive mode, Disney character handles. 2-minute timer with music. Magic Timer app gamifies brushing.

philips-sonicare-kids-bluetooth.review: Sonic vibration, Bluetooth app with interactive characters. 2 modes, 2 speeds. Best for older kids 7+.

brusheez-kids-electric-set.review: Includes brush, rinse cup, 2-min sand timer, character holder. Battery-powered, soft bristles. Best gift set.

frida-baby-smilefrida-toothbrush.review: Triple-angle bristles reach top, bottom, side simultaneously. 1-3 years. Soft handle for tiny grips.

colgate-kids-manual-batman.review: Pack of 4 manual brushes, soft bristles, suction-cup base. Cheapest option for toddler training brushes.

pinDescription: 5 kids toothbrushes tested by real children 2-8 for 60 days. Oral-B vs Philips vs Brusheez vs Frida vs Colgate. Plaque reduction, compliance data. #kidstoothbrush
